The full web e2e suite finished after my handback and failed: exit 1, with 360 passed, 9 failed and 15 not run, over 1.3 hours. I've added these final numbers to the handback (§4 and §8).

- **Failures:** all 9 are "Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded" in older DG2–DG4 specs. I raised no timeouts. Three of the failing specs cover pages I edited: the BAU handover, benefit and meeting pages, which carry a one-line badge or the new T14 form-tools section. So I can't rule out a real effect there until they are rerun on a quiet machine.
- **Not run:** the 15 tests are the later steps of serial specs, skipped after a failure in the same spec.
- **My own spec:** `p5-forms.spec.ts` was not among the failures in the full suite; its standalone run passed 6/6.
- **Load:** the machine was at a load average of about 20 throughout, from the four concurrent W15 tasks plus my run.

**Still needed from you:** run the full e2e suite and both `pnpm test` runs on the merged tree on a quiet machine. Acceptance item 2 and the full suite are not met in this run. Everything else in the handback is unchanged, and the work remains uncommitted.
